content.introduction: The Disability Resource Center provides accommodations and support services to ensure equal access to education for students with disabilities.

sections.title: Who We Serve
sections.content:
Students with:
- Learning disabilities
- ADHD
- Physical disabilities
- Chronic health conditions
- Psychological disabilities
- Sensory impairments
- Temporary disabilities

All disabilities must be documented by a qualified professional.

sections.title: Getting Started
sections.content:
Registration Process:
1. Complete intake form
2. Submit documentation
3. Schedule meeting with coordinator
4. Discuss accommodation needs
5. Receive accommodation letter
6. Share with instructors

Timeline:
- Submit documentation early
- Allow 2-3 weeks for processing
- Accommodations not retroactive

sections.title: Common Accommodations
sections.content:
Academic:
- Extended time on exams (50-100%)
- Reduced distraction testing environment
- Note-taking assistance
- Priority registration
- Flexible attendance policies

Technology:
- Screen readers
- Text-to-speech software
- Recording permission
- Accessible course materials

Housing:
- Single room
- Accessible room features
- Emotional support animal approval

sections.title: Testing Center
sections.content:
Exam Accommodations:
- Schedule exams in advance (5 business days)
- Quiet, private testing rooms
- Assistive technology available
- Extended time administered

How to Schedule:
1. Confirm with instructor
2. Submit request online
3. Receive confirmation
4. Arrive 10 minutes early

sections.title: Contact Information
sections.content:
Location: Student Success Center, Room 150
Phone: (555) 123-4570
Email: disability@university.edu

Hours:
Monday-Friday: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Appointments recommended but walk-ins welcome.

content.conclusion: Accommodations are designed to provide equal access, not an unfair advantage. We're here to help you succeed!
